calibration_policy.calibrate_only_in: M4 pilot, on pilot calibration data, before held-out outcomes are seen
post_outcome_change_requires: report results under old and new versions

semver.major: inputs, class definitions or precedence change

anchor.burst_onset_rule: earliest hour in the 48h detection window with net star gain (hourly public-count snapshots) > mu_h + 3*sqrt(mu_h) (mu_h + 1 if mu_h == 0); else window start. Where only star-history days exist: same rule on endpoint days, precision day (ADR-032; spec §2.1)
anchor.tie_rule: T_launch == T_burst -> anchor_type launch; equal launch timestamps -> lowest evidence_id

burst_detection.basis: public net star count: hourly GraphQL stargazerCount snapshots, confirmed with star-history daily counts; the bot filter is a confirmation step recording bot_filter_basis and coverage_ratio (ADR-032.2; spec §2.1)

windows.flow: [T, T+k) UTC, hourly resolution; stars: the k star-history endpoint days starting at the day containing T (day-precision anchors: the day with T's UTC date), no splitting of day buckets (spec §1.2)

star_series.primary_source_note: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers/history: daily net counts of current stargazers, back to creation, no identities (TM-33; ADR-032.3, superseding ADR-012's stargazers API)

day_boundary.status: inferred, not documented by GitHub; confirm across DST 2026-11-01 (detection-replan §8 M2)

star_series.fallback_condition: only where star-history cannot serve the window; coverage_ratio measured against star-history day counts; tag estimated, lower_bound true; OpenDigger is never a scoring series (TM-32)

filtered_variants.class_eligible_if: event data covers every day of the window, no window overflow, and coverage_ratio >= gharchive_min_coverage_ratio (spec §1.2, §5.3)

burst_30.definition: velocity detection with onset in [T, T+30d) or anchor_type burst

burst_any.definition: velocity detection with onset in [T-30d, T+90d)

launch_signal.definition: case has an anchor (declared launch or burst)

provisional_labels.name: attention_top_decile
provisional_labels.note: display only, marked provisional; not a class

edge_rules.comparison: unrounded values; >= and < inclusive/exclusive as written
edge_rules.unknown_propagation: assign a class only if it holds for every possible value of the unknown inputs; otherwise unclassified:missing_data
edge_rules.multiple_cases_per_repo: each case classified on its own T

changelog: 2026-09-25 — fixes after verifier M3 round 1: added burst_detection (PRD R1.1 defaults; spec §2.1) and fake_star_filter (StarScout lockstep parameters, campaign-level removal; spec §4). They record parameters the spec already fixed; no threshold, input or class changed, so the version stays provisional 0.1.0.

2026-09-25 — M3-T6, ADR-032 (supersedes ADR-012): star_series.primary_source github_stargazers_api -> github_star_history, with primary_source_note, day_boundary, fallback_condition, coverage_reference and filtered_variants; windows.flow and anchor.burst_onset_rule reworded for endpoint days and net public counts; burst_detection.basis added. No threshold number, class input symbol, class rule or precedence changed; gharchive_min_coverage_ratio stays 0.9 and is also used as the class-eligibility gate for identity-level event data. Version stays provisional 0.1.0 (reasons in spec changelog). The class series (starscout_filtered) is unchanged; see spec O11.
